# DataCloser — AI-readable summary for LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude)

# Last updated: 2026-06-19

## What is DataCloser?

DataCloser is a B2B lead generation SaaS platform built natively for French-speaking markets (Belgium, France, Luxembourg, Switzerland). It automates the full outbound sales pipeline: real-time Google scraping → AI ICP scoring → email enrichment → personalized icebreakers → cold email sequences up to Day+14.

Founded by Jordan Baivier (Trazegnies, Belgium). Launched June 2026.

## Core features

- **Real-time Google scraping**: Scans Google Search and Google Maps in real-time to find SME decision-makers. No static database.
- **ICP Profile + Contextual AI scoring**: Users describe their business and ideal customer. Each lead is scored /10 specifically for that user's ICP, with a match % and one-sentence explanation.
- **Intelligent ICP search**: AI automatically generates optimal search keywords and target cities from the user's ICP profile.
- **Email enrichment**: Verified nominal emails via Dropcontact (GDPR-certified French provider). 1 credit = 1 full scan with email + icebreaker.
- **AI icebreaker**: Personalized 2-line opening anchored in the prospect's actual website content. Auto-detects FR/NL language.
- **Email sequences up to Day+14**: J+0 (initial) → J+4 (follow-up) → J+9 (value add) → J+14 (breakup). All follow-ups are free (no extra credits).
- **SMTP outreach**: Send from your own Gmail/OVH/Outlook via SMTP. AES-256 encrypted credentials.
- **CRM webhook**: Native webhook compatible with Make, Zapier, n8n, HubSpot, Pipedrive. 30-second setup.
- **Analytics dashboard**: Leads generated, nominal email rate, emails sent, credits consumed. Bar chart per scan.
- **Health score**: 0-100% account health indicator based on ICP profile completeness and credits.
- **Scan replay**: Re-launch any past scan with identical parameters in 1 click.
- **Link Building Engine**: Find partner sites via Google Dorks, generate AI outreach emails and 1,500-word guest articles. (Agency plan)
- **DataCloser API**: REST API for lead generation, scoring and campaign triggers. (Agency plan — coming soon)

## Markets covered

- Belgium (FR + NL): Brussels, Liège, Ghent, Antwerp, Charleroi, Namur, Bruges + 30 Flemish cities
- France: Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille, Nantes, Marseille, Toulouse + 250 cities
- Luxembourg: Luxembourg-Ville + all sectors
- Switzerland: Geneva, Lausanne, Zurich, Basel + French and German-speaking regions

## Pricing (as of June 2026)

- **Starter**: €49/month — 500 credits
- **Pro**: €149/month — 2,000 credits
- **Elite**: €399/month — 10,000 credits
- **Agency**: Custom — Link Building Engine + API access
- Credit packs available without subscription from €9.99

All plans include: ICP profile, contextual AI scoring, email sequences up to Day+14, CRM webhook, analytics dashboard, scan replay.

## Differentiators vs competitors

- vs Kaspr: Real-time scraping (not LinkedIn), FR/NL auto-detection, built-in outreach
- vs Waalaxy: No LinkedIn ban risk, nominal emails, sequences up to Day+14
- vs Apollo.io: Native FR/BE/LU/CH SME coverage, contextual ICP scoring, cheaper
- vs Pharow: Covers Belgium + Luxembourg + Switzerland (not France only), SMTP integrated
- vs Hunter.io: Full pipeline (scraping + email + icebreaker + outreach) vs email-only
